components.name: Question Field
components.description: Persistent question composer for the research corpus.
components.html: <label class="ds-query-label">Ask the corpus<input class="ds-query-input" placeholder="Enter a research question…"></label>
components.css: .ds-query-label { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #b9ccc8; font: 400 14px/1.4 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; } .ds-query-input { min-height: 3.4rem; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #42e8c8; border-radius: 0; background: #09232b; color: #f4faf7; font: inherit; } .ds-query-input::placeholder { color: #9db6b1; opacity: 1; } .ds-query-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ff6b35; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Destructive or secondary action in the corpus rail.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { min-height: 2.7rem; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(66, 232, 200, .28); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #e8f2ef; font: 400 14px/1.4 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, border-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-ghost:hover { border-color: #42e8c8; background: #42e8c8; color: #06171d; } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ff6b35; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Conversation Plate
components.description: A source answer or question held on the evidence reading surface.
components.html:
Source-locked output

Answer content with [Source: filename, page N] citations.
components.css: .ds-chat-plate { position: relative; max-width: 72ch; padding: 1.25rem 1.35rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: rgba(232, 242, 239, .055); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(232, 242, 239, .13); color: #e8f2ef; font: 400 16px/1.65 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; } .ds-chat-plate::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 10px; right: 10px; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-top: 1px solid #42e8c8; border-right: 1px solid #42e8c8; } .ds-chat-plate strong { color: #f4faf7; } .ds-chat-plate p { margin: 8px 0 0; }

components.name: Corpus Readout
components.description: Three live corpus counts presented on a single ruled rail.
components.css: .ds-readout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); border-top: 1px solid rgba(66, 232, 200, .28); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(66, 232, 200, .28); color: #b9ccc8; font: 400 11px/1.3 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-readout > div { padding: 12px 6px 10px 0; } .ds-readout > div + div { padding-left: 10px; border-left: 1px solid rgba(232, 242, 239, .13); } .ds-readout strong { display: block; color: #f4faf7; font: 600 28px/1 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
The interface treats research as material to inspect. A deep ink workbench holds one illuminated conversation plate, while small registration lines and restrained signal colors make system state visible. The visual character comes from the contrast between the dark archive rail and the pale, readable evidence surface; it does not imitate a physical film texture.

The system is dense where corpus status and controls need to be scanned, then gives answers a broad reading measure. Motion is reserved for one scan pass on entry and short control-state transitions. The mobile view collapses the corpus rail so the welcome, conversation and question field remain usable without a sideways layout.
keyCharacteristics: Deep ink surfaces with a mint registration accent.
Square, ruled controls and conversation plates.
Condensed display type paired with a highly legible body face.
Citation text remains the visual focus of each answer.

rules.name: The Signal-Role Rule
rules.body: Mint marks active structure; orange marks attention. Do not swap their roles casually.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Keep Barlow Condensed for display and compact labels; use Atkinson Hyperlegible for sentences and citations.

dos: Do keep source citations visible and readable inside answers.
Do reserve mint for active structure and orange for attention or focus.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion and keep content visible when motion is disabled.
Do keep the mobile sidebar collapsed initially.
donts: Don't use gradients on display text.
Don't add decorative textures that reduce citation contrast.
Don't use rounded chat bubbles or nested card shells.
Don't let color be the only signal for focus, loading or error.
